title: AgentOps Yield Ledger Event v1
description: A durable, append-only, BEAD-KEYED operational event in the dynamo yield ledger. Built for ag-grcz3 (the instrument) and read by ag-qzinh (the gauges) per .agents/specs/2026-06-14-yield-vector-and-ledger-event-gap.md. Today no such stream exists: the EventBus is in-memory only, verdictledger is directive-scoped, the rpi ledger is run-scoped, and PROV is an edge ledger — so per-bead yield (A, R, A/R, Q, E, L) is not computable from data. This schema closes that gap. Every event carries the common envelope {event, bead_id, run_id, ts, body}; the body is a typed payload discriminated by `event` (accept | gate-verdict | usage). The gate-verdict body REFERENCES a pawl-verdict by pawl_verdict_ref (bead_id+head_sha) and PROJECTS its fields — it does NOT inline or mutate the closed pawl-verdict.v1 object (additionalProperties:false). author_family, cross_family, and difficulty live ONLY here, never written back to the pawl-verdict. Emission is fail-open observability, not a gate: it must never block a merge. The runtime artifact is append-only JSONL at .agents/yield/yield-ledger.jsonl (untracked) — ONE event envelope per line so concurrent fungible lanes can each O_APPEND without read-modify-write contention; each line conforms to one of the accept | gate-verdict | usage event $defs below. This schema and its fixtures are tracked.

generated_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp when this ledger file was last rewritten.

events.description: Append-only events in emission order (oldest first). accept, gate-verdict, and usage events are interleaved on the timeline and discriminated by the `event` field of the envelope.

accept_event.description: A bead reached gated merge to trunk (terminal accept). Feeds gauge A.

run_id.description: The factory run/cycle this event belongs to.

merge_sha.description: The trunk commit the bead merged as.

merged_by.description: The identity (orchestrator/lane) that performed the merge.

gate_verdict_ref.description: Reference (bead_id+head_sha) to the authorizing pawl-verdict — NOT inlined.

gate_verdict_event.description: A review panel completed on a bead. EVERY attempted bead emits >=1 (including a REFUTE). Feeds gauges Q and E. PROJECTS a pawl-verdict by reference; carries the difficulty weight, author_family (emit-time orchestrator input), and derived SoD bits that live ONLY in the yield ledger.

bead_id.description: The attempted bead this verdict reviewed.

run_id.description: The factory run/cycle this event belongs to.

ts.description: RFC3339 timestamp of the gate verdict.

difficulty.description: Scope weight w — intrinsic to the bead, set by a non-author (see spec §F). Lives on gate-verdict so attempted-but-rejected beads are still weight-able in Q's denominator. Q is difficulty-weighted; trivial beads contribute little to numerator AND denominator.

pawl_verdict_ref.description: Reference (bead_id+head_sha) to the projected pawl-verdict.v1 — NOT inlined; pawl-verdict.v1 is closed.

disposition.description: Projected panel disposition. ESCALATE/HOLD feed E (autonomy watch).

head_sha.description: Commit-binding: the PR head the panel reviewed. A verdict goes STALE on re-push, blocking gate-shopping across re-pushes — makes 'clean first pass' verifiable for Q.

attempt.description: Which re-gate attempt produced this verdict. attempt>1 plus usage{phase:rework} rows is how rework is attributed (no separate event).

mode.description: Projected pawl diversity mode (optional; absent => fresh-context). `deterministic` marks a verdict from the deterministic gate tier — what emit-deterministic-catch.sh writes for a gate-blocked catch (matches Go validMode/ModeDeterministic).

domain.description: Optional bounded-context / work-class tag the verdict happened in (e.g. concurrency, gate-policy, docs). Gives the slow loop a dimension to query escapes by. (age-membrane-memory-j9c6.1)

reason.description: Optional verdict rationale; on a REFUTED verdict it is the what-was-missed signal a derived membrane-check is built from. (age-membrane-memory-j9c6.1)

class.description: Optional SEMANTIC class slug supplied at emit (--class). When present it — not the free-text reason — is the class-identity component of class_key, so the same label on DIFFERENT beads collapses to ONE cross-bead class (a reason-derived key drifts with bead-specific wording and stayed invisible). Absent on historical rows, which key from reason. Slug shape: lowercase [a-z0-9] words joined by '-'. (age-jjt8)

author_context_id.description: The authoring worker session's context id (projected from the pawl-verdict). Used to derive author_ne_reviewer.

refuter_families.description: Canonical model families among the refuters (projected). Used to derive cross_family.

author_family.description: The authoring lane's model family — an EMIT-TIME input from the orchestrator that dispatched the authoring lane, NOT read from the pawl-verdict (which has no author-family field). Lives ONLY in the yield ledger.

cross_family.description: Derived: >=2 distinct canonical families among the refuters.

author_ne_reviewer.description: Derived: author_context_id is NOT among the refuter context ids (author != reviewer).

evidence_present.description: Derived: the pawl-verdict.sh panel-or-refuter evidence check passed (a review actually ran).

detector_pattern.description: On an overturning-REFUTED, a regex the membrane compiles into a draft constraint so the escape's class is mechanically re-introducible. Absent -> the finding stays advisory. (EM.2.10; schema-added with the catch fields, epic age-zpj5 S1)

constraint_path_globs.description: Path globs scoping detector_pattern when compiled into a constraint. (EM.2.10)

class_key.description: Catch-native, versioned class identity for a REFUTED catch: v1:slug(domain)/slug(normalized reason)[/slug(detector)], computed at emit. Lets recall + recurrence group catches without anyone authoring a regex. (epic age-zpj5, membrane PROVE-FIRST S1)

affected_paths.description: Concrete repo-relative FILE paths from the reviewed diff, INDEPENDENT of detector metadata so a judgment-class catch (no detector) is still path-recallable. (epic age-zpj5, S1)

usage_event.description: Per-bead model spend was observed. Feeds gauges R, L, and A/R. The category_hint is an emit-time best guess; the authoritative L classification is a read-time join (ag-qzinh) — this row is never mutated to reclassify.

bead_id.description: The bead this spend is attributed to.

run_id.description: The factory run/cycle this event belongs to.

ts.description: RFC3339 timestamp of the usage observation.

model.description: The model that incurred the spend.

phase.description: Which phase of the bead's lifecycle this spend occurred in.

category_hint.description: Emit-time best-guess loss category. ADVISORY ONLY — the authoritative L classification is a read-time join in ag-qzinh; a row emitted 'productive' on a bead later REFUTED is correctly counted as loss without mutating the ledger.

pawl_verdict_ref.description: A reference to a pawl-verdict.v1 object by bead_id + head_sha — the link between the yield ledger and the (closed) pawl-verdict schema. Never inlines or mutates the pawl-verdict.
